title: New tower connects 5,600 residents
desc: DODOMA: OVER 5,600 residents of Qash Ward in Babati District, Manyara Region are now connected to mobile and internet services following the construction of a new communication tower under a nationwide connectivity programme. The tower, constructed by Vodacom Tanzania, provides 2G, 3G and 4G services and also serves residents in Endadosh Village and surrounding hamlets.
